reddit.title: Improving Colony Music Experience in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to the way music plays in Provincia. No more abrupt cuts in your colony's soundtrack! With our new soft music reloops, transitions between day, night, and combat beds are smoother than ever. Check out the details on our devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops

posts: Exciting news! We've enhanced the audio experience in Provincia. Say goodbye to jarring music transitions and hello to smooth reloops!
